items.description: The stock_records migration downgrades then upgrades as a single reversible step under @pytest.mark.migration without downgrading to base
Rows seeded with a per-run-unique key before the additive migration survive it intact with their expected values on the real branch
The integration suite runs against the real Lakebase branch with no in-memory or mocked DB driver configured
The boundary layer (app/routes) contains no ORM or session imports
The service layer (app/services) contains no ORM or session imports
No hardcoded database connection string exists anywhere in the app
The database connection reads DATABASE_URL from the environment
The resolved DATABASE_URL points at databricks_postgres with the database name not renamed or made app-specific
A write with a null sku is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real branch
A write with a null location is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real branch
A write with a null quantity is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real branch
A write with a null inventory_code is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real branch
The service layer rejects a write that would drive quantity below zero before it reaches the repository
POSTing a stock record to the stock API with a uuid-suffixed SKU, location, quantity, and inventory_code returns a 2xx status
app/routes performs no server-side template rendering and returns JSON only
GETting a previously filed stock record from the stock API returns a response body whose quantity matches exactly what was filed
GETting a previously filed stock record from the stock API returns a response body whose inventory_code matches exactly what was filed
A repeat write for the same (sku, location) collapses to exactly one stored row for that pair on the real branch, enforced by the DB unique constraint
A write with a negative quantity is rejected by the DB CHECK (quantity >= 0) on the real branch with no negative row stored
A concurrent repeat file for one (sku, location) resolves in a single transaction leaving exactly one row for that pair on the real branch
An in-place upsert for an existing (sku, location) leaves created_at unchanged on the real branch
Filing a stock record a second time for the same uuid-suffixed SKU and location pair returns a 2xx response
After two filings for the same uuid-suffixed SKU and location pair, GETting that record returns the quantity from the second filing
